proves: The device validates the 16-bit request checksum. A frame identical to the baseline except for checksum+1 is still answered, but result byte 3 is 0x02 instead of 0x00.

request.checksumAlgorithm: LE16 sum of bytes 0..45 inclusive (HIDC included)

notes: checksum-1 produces the identical 0x02 reply (same capture, exchange 4), so the check is an equality test, not a range or parity heuristic.
The device always answers with a valid response checksum, including error replies.
